explication: RocksDB is an embeddable persistent key-value store built around an LSM design. A caller opens a database and uses its public API to read or write key-value data; internally, the product also manages storage files, compaction, caches, and backup/restore. The README establishes the LSM and multithreaded-compaction roles, while the source index exposes selected implementation dependencies. Many detailed runtime connections are not shown in the excerpts, so those are omitted rather than inferred.
